notes.text: Psalm . This is a community lament, describing a time when liars are in positions of authority.
The particular kinds of lies described are flattering lips and insincere speech (a double heart). Such people manipulate others for the sake of gain (v. 2).
cut off. By removing them from his people (see Lev. 20:3).
True Israelites will not oppress the poor and needy but will care for them (see Deut. 15:11; 24:14). When the poor are oppressed, God takes action (compare Ps. 9:18).
God’s words are pure, refined, and purified; they are free of the impurities of lies, flattery, or insincerity (see v. 2).
Them probably refers to the poor and needy (v. 5) and the godly (v. 1).
This final verse describes again the conditions described in vv. 1–2. Ending on this somber note reminds the faithful of their constant dependence on God.
